note: Expected findings are the code, path, message, suggestion and valid values `orb validate --json` (the Rust validator) reports for the same materialized upstream/consumer pair. Each case feeds the unresolved consumer and the import, resolved and lowered again, pruned to the trait fields the rule reads, as the call sites input. When a rename names an event the declaration alone does not, the case also drives the std-orb-lint-input request and the std-orb-fired-events round trip: the FIRED_HEARD payload is what the real std-orb-fired-events answers for the offered trait. Cases mirror trait_ref_config_rules.rs (a-h and the G-ORB-030 required trait knob) and std_behavior_use.rs (the events rename), plus the refId and fired-event cases.
